(bush in NW corner) |description = {{Description|decoration}} }} The '''Junimo Plush''' is a secret piece of [[furniture]]. It can be found by clicking the bush in the northwest corner of [[Pelican Town]] on the 28th of any [[Seasons|season]] at exactly 12:00pm. The instructions for finding the Junimo Plush can be found in [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #13|Secret Note #13]], though finding the note is not necessary to collect a Junimo Plush from the bush. If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
